name: prbox
description: PR Box — registro de PRs e cargas por percentual para boxes de cross training

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
